heading.vision-title:
A portfolio shaped
by the needs of trade.
meta.001: MarketVision Technology owns, develops and operates a portfolio of platforms for African commerce, logistics communication and transport visibility.
copy.007: We own, develop and operate digital platforms for African trade, supporting business discovery, access to logistics providers and visibility across transport networks.
access.004: Illustration of an AfricMade supplier showroom
copy.021: Farm produce, handmade goods and manufactured products in a supplier showroom, with a location map and an enquiry form.
copy.028: AfricMade brings African farms, manufacturers and independent makers into a marketplace built around the supplier. Each showroom combines product collections with business and location details, giving buyers a fuller picture of who they are buying from.
access.006: Illustration of the Loadgistic transport map
copy.035: A map of vehicles and routes beside a truck showing available cargo space, a private sharing option and shipment progress.
copy.040: Loadgistic makes vehicle availability and routes visible across transport networks. Transporters decide what to share publicly and what to make available only to selected customers, while shippers and brokers can review capacity and keep track of providers they work with.
copy.057: We welcome enquiries about our platforms, partnerships and other opportunities to work together.

purpose.context: Choosing a supplier, arranging delivery and finding suitable transport each require different information and relationships. MarketVision develops focused platforms around these needs, bringing commerce, logistics communication and transport visibility into a common portfolio.
portfolio.cargochatterTitle: Connect customers directly with logistics providers.
portfolio.cargochatterBody: CargoChatter embeds logistics provider profiles and live chat in websites and apps. Customers can explore services, discuss their shipment requirements and request quotes directly from a provider, for anything from a parcel to a full load.
portfolio.cargochatterAlt: Illustration of a logistics provider profile beside a chat window on a business website
portfolio.africmadeDetail: Enquiries can cover a single product or a list for a larger order, with availability and terms discussed directly between buyer and supplier.
portfolio.loadgisticDetail: Agreed shipments can then be followed through private updates, giving the people involved a shared view of progress.
portfolio.cargochatterControl: Platform owners choose which providers appear, shaping a logistics offering around their customers while keeping the conversation within their own site or app.
company.role: As the parent company, we guide the direction, development and ongoing operation of each platform. Each has a distinct purpose, with room to grow around the businesses and customers it serves.
portfolio.intro: Three platforms, serving distinct needs across commerce and logistics.
perspective.label: OUR PERSPECTIVE
perspective.heading:
Wider participation
in African trade.
perspective.body: Many commercial opportunities begin within an existing network. We see room to extend that reach: for producers to be discovered beyond their immediate market, for customers to find and speak with logistics providers, and for transporters to make their capacity visible to more of the businesses that need it.
perspective.commitment: That is the purpose behind our portfolio. We build for those everyday decisions, and continue developing the platforms as the relationships and needs around them change.
